  echo: false

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)

excursion_description <- paste0(
  "1) An introduction to multiple non-profit organizations that conduct ",
  "sponsored research in policy-relevant industry studies, including the ",
  "Center for Strategic & International Studies (CSIS), the McKinsey Global ",
  "Institute (MGI), MITRE, and the Niskanen Center.\n\n",
  "2) A walking tour of the Washington National Mall"
)

overview <- read_csv(
  "data/overview.csv",
  col_types = cols(.default = "c")
) |>
  rename(
    weekday = Weekday,
    time_start = `Time Start`,
    time_end = `Time End`,
    duration = Duration,
    session = Session,
    building = Building
  ) |>
  mutate(
    date = case_when(
      weekday == "Wednesday" ~ as.Date("2026-06-03"),
      weekday == "Thursday" ~ as.Date("2026-06-04"),
      weekday == "Friday" ~ as.Date("2026-06-05")
    ),
    time_range = paste0(time_start, " \u2013 ", time_end)
  ) |>
  select(date, weekday, time_range, session, building)

days <- list(
  list(date = as.Date("2026-06-03"), label = "Wednesday, June 3, 2026"),
  list(date = as.Date("2026-06-04"), label = "Thursday, June 4, 2026"),
  list(date = as.Date("2026-06-05"), label = "Friday, June 5, 2026")
)
```

```{r}
#| label: schedule-output
#| results: asis
for (d in days) {
  cat("# ", d$label, "\n\n", sep = "")

  day_data <- overview |>
    filter(date == d$date)

  if (d$date == as.Date("2026-06-03")) {
    # Wednesday: group by building with subheadings
    for (bldg in unique(day_data$building)) {
      cat("### ", bldg, "\n\n", sep = "")
      bldg_data <- day_data |> filter(building == bldg)

      # Morning excursion: output separately to avoid newlines breaking the table
      excursion <- bldg_data |> filter(session == "Morning excursion")
      rest <- bldg_data |> filter(session != "Morning excursion")

      if (nrow(excursion) > 0) {
        cat("**", excursion$time_range, "** Morning excursion\n\n", sep = "")
        cat(excursion_description, "\n\n", sep = "")
      }

      if (nrow(rest) > 0) {
        tbl <- rest |> select(Time = time_range, Session = session)
        print(kable(tbl, format = "pipe"))
        cat("\n\n")
      }
    }
  } else {
    tbl <- day_data |>
      select(Time = time_range, Session = session, Location = building)
    print(kable(tbl, format = "pipe"))
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```
